source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Seven sources resolved directly; three ACM DOI targets resolved but denied automated page retrieval, so their use is limited to durable bibliographic/theorem attribution rather than inaccessible quotations.

numerical_recomputation.notes: Recomputed every leaf sum, internal combine, tree count, work, span, depth, range coverage, ratio, and exercise value.

evidence: Sibling work adds while ideal sibling span takes a maximum; adding the parent's continuation/combine yields the stated recursive work/span relations.
For a full binary logical tree, induction from one leaf shows internal nodes L-1 and total nodes 2L-1; the processor and critical-path necessities yield max(T1/P,T_infinity).
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The calculations require the stated strict nested, independent-child, cost, and ideal-processor model and are not generalized to arbitrary executors or effects.

evidence: Reviewed empty/singleton and cutoff boundaries, odd splits, nondecreasing recursion, skewed quicksort, excessive leaves, stack depth, overlapping slices, combine order, and simultaneous child failures.

Reviewed one-worker execution, saturated fixed pools, non-helping joins, blocking I/O, locks/permits, nested pools, stealing/locality/NUMA, cancellation races, partial effects, and safety-critical use.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary review covers termination, ownership, task/memory bounds, scheduling liveness, numeric/result semantics, failure, and deployment claims.

evidence: Every spawned child has one owning scope and terminal observation; child regions are immutable/disjoint/synchronized; joins precede dependent combine and publish child outcomes.
Recursive size decreases, live tasks/depth/memory/effects are bounded, waiters do not monopolize child execution resources, and failure settles all started descendants before scope exit.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked invariants across split, fork, local execution, steal, join, combine, child failure, sibling cancellation, retry, cleanup, and publication.

evidence: The executable-tree induction starts with cutoff leaves whose work/span equal element count; each internal node adds child work plus one and maximum child span plus one.
Termination follows from nonnegative integer range measure and strictly smaller recursive non-base children; coverage follows adjacent half-open splits at mid.
proof_review.notes: Proof arguments are scoped to balanced deterministic split, exact integers, unit costs, and finite input; runtime scheduling and performance remain empirical.

evidence: The Blumofe-Leiserson result is attributed and qualified by fully strict, scheduler, processor, and cost assumptions rather than claimed for every pool.
Executable limitations exclude task spawning, scheduling, stealing, memory publication, overhead, locality, blocking, lifecycle, effects, devices, and performance.

Cutoff, task overhead, steals, locality, NUMA, blocking, allocation, scaling, and cancellation latency are explicitly assigned to measured evidence.
